rationale: The workflow already implements dependency caching: ruby/setup-ruby@v1 with bundler-cache: true caches Ruby gems based on Gemfile.lock, and actions/cache@v6 caches rswag-ui/node_modules and vendor/bundle. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, so adding or duplicating caching is not supported. Other candidate patterns either lack measured evidence for this workflow (most are simulation_estimate or guidance), have contraindications that apply (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST would cancel matrix outcomes needed for Ruby/Rails compatibility coverage; P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative timing data and risks false failures on slow matrix cells), or require infrastructure changes beyond the workflow file (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE needs trusted distributed cache infrastructure). No supported optimization with measured evidence applies without weakening coverage or adding risk.
